components.goal: Cancel even Taylor terms in the ball-smoothed gradient without a dimension penalty in the remainder.
components.key_estimate: Bias <=B_beta h^(beta-1), second moment <=V_beta d^2/h^2. C_tay=Gamma(alpha+1)/Gamma(beta), B_beta=C_tay sum_j |w_j|r_j^(beta-1), V_beta=81(sum_j |w_j|)^2+(1/2)sum_j w_j^2/r_j^2. All depend only on beta.
components.name: Finite-radius spherical bias cancellation
components.operation: G_r=d(Y(x+rU)-Y(x-rU))U/(2r) has mean E_V grad f(x+rV), V uniform on unit ball. Combine radii r_jh using w_j; sum_j w_j=1 and sum_j w_j r_j^(2ell)=0 for ell=1,...,J.
components.requires: x in B_2(1), h in (0,1], fixed beta>2 and the stated multilinear operator-norm Holder condition; independent fresh noises across signs/scales.
support_refs: Same Source Proposition D.1 and D.4.
transfer_checks: Prove vector Taylor remainder in the chosen norm; scalar tensor-to-vector conversion here uses Euclidean duality.
Check query domain and recompute noise covariance when altering freshness or pairing.

components.cost_effect: n estimates consume 2qn values; output averaging requires no oracle calls.
components.full_local_argument: Let R_t=E||x_t-x*||^2, Delta_t=E[f(x_t)-f(x*)], eta_t=4/(t+1). Nonexpansive projection, strong convexity and 2B||x_t-x*|| <=||x_t-x*||^2/2+2B^2 give R_{t+1}<=(1-eta_t/2)R_t-2eta_t Delta_t+2eta_t B^2+eta_t^2 M. Rearranging yields Delta_t<=((t-1)R_t-(t+1)R_{t+1})/8+B^2+2M/(t+1). Multiply by t and sum t=1,...,n: the distance terms telescope to -n(n+1)R_{n+1}/8<=0, and sum t/(t+1)<=n. Therefore sum t Delta_t <=n(n+1)B^2/2+2Mn. Convexity at the weighted average gives the claimed bound. No small-step condition is used.
components.goal: Convert bounded conditional bias and second moment to expected function gap without logarithmic loss.
components.key_estimate: E[f(xbar_n)-f(x*)]<=B^2+4M/(n+1). Complete short argument is included below.
components.name: Weighted projected stochastic-gradient telescope
components.operation: Use the main variant's step 4/(t+1), projection and weights proportional to t.
components.requires: 1-strong convexity on B_2(1), x* in B_2(1), conditional bias norm <=B and conditional second moment <=M.
support_refs: Same Source Lemma D.2 and D.5, pp.16,19.
transfer_checks: Retain conditional, history-based bias and second-moment bounds; pointwise unconditional estimates alone are insufficient.

components.cost_effect: Fallback uses zero calls; large branch uses at most T.
components.goal: Cover budgets too small for one full stochastic-gradient iteration.
components.key_estimate: Large branch gap <=B_beta^2 h^(2beta-2)+4V_beta d^2/((n+1)h^2)=O_beta((d^2/n)^p), and n>=T/(4q). Small branch has f(0)-f(x*)<=3||x*||^2/2<=3/2 while min{1,(d^2/T)^p}>=(2q)^(-p). Thus one beta-dependent constant covers all budgets.
components.name: All-budget calibration
components.operation: Use the main variant's threshold and h, or return the origin.

transfer_checks: Change the fallback loss and threshold when changing radius or normalization.

performance_links.scope_note: Upper half only; all positive integers d,T and fixed beta>2, expected final objective gap. Lower bound covers a broader algorithm class.

variants.cost: Exactly 2q independently noisy scalar values per iteration and 2qn<=T total; same U_t does not mean same noise. All queried points lie in B_2(2). No gradient or exact function value is queried; arithmetic, random-direction generation and projection are not counted as oracle calls.
variants.name: All-budget normalized expected-gap method
variants.output: For the iteration branch, xbar_n=2 sum_{t=1}^n t x_t/[n(n+1)], lying in B_2(1); for the fallback branch output 0. The average uses pre-update x_t, not x_{t+1}.
public_inputs: Positive integers d,T; fixed beta>2; Definition 3.1 normalization and known unit minimizer-radius bound.
variants.query_and_update: At each t draw U_t uniform on S^(d-1), independent of pre-iteration history. Query x_t+r_j h U_t and x_t-r_j h U_t for all j, using 2q independent fresh noises, with the same direction across scales. Form ghat_h(x_t)=sum_j w_j [d/(2r_j h)](Y_{j,+}-Y_{j,-})U_t. Set x_{t+1}=Proj_{B_2(1)}(x_t-4 ghat_h(x_t)/(t+1)).
variants.requirements: For fixed finite real beta>2, k=ceil(beta)-1, alpha=beta-k in (0,1], p=(beta-1)/beta. F_beta(d) consists of f:R^d->R in C^k, with unique global minimizer x* in the closed Euclidean unit ball, and for every x,y in R^d: f(y)>=f(x)+<grad f(x),y-x>+||y-x||^2/2; ||grad f(x)-grad f(y)||<=3||x-y||; ||D^k f(x)-D^k f(y)||_op<=||x-y||^alpha. The operator norm is sup |A[u1,...,uk]| over independently chosen unit-ball directions. Oracle provides fresh independent N(0,1) additive noise at all queried values. Projection onto the public Euclidean unit ball and fresh sphere directions are available computational operations.
variants.state_and_initialization: Set k=ceil(beta)-1, alpha=beta-k, J=floor((k-1)/2), q=J+1, r_j=2^(-j) for j=0,...,J and w_j=product_{ell!=j}[-r_ell^2/(r_j^2-r_ell^2)], with empty product 1. If entering the iteration branch, initialize x_1=0.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: If T<2q d^2, return 0 with no queries. Otherwise set n=floor(T/(2q))>=d^2 and h=(d^2/n)^(1/(2beta))<=1, and perform t=1,...,n iterations. Leave unused raw budget unused.
